events.rationale: Fade the crowded energy-hawk / BoC-must-hike book by shorting 2027 implied CORRA (receiving Canada 2027). Explicitly not the trade: long AUDCAD at a 5y extreme, long JPY after a 99th-percentile leveraged-fund pile-in, or joining residual US duration shorts.

FACT: Oct-26 AONIA implies 4.565 (+21.5bp) on 21752 open interest and 4450 volume; Jun-27 implies 4.94 (+59bp). FACT: AU 2Y/5Y/10Y are 4.999/5.041/5.348, each the 99th 1y and 99th 5y percentile. FACT: CFTC TFF 2026-09-15 shows AUD futures OI at the 99th 1y/3y percentile (z 3.61/5.42) after +37673 contracts, but leveraged-fund AUD net is only the 31.7th 1y percentile; AUDCAD/AUDNZD sit at the 99.8th 1y and 99.96th 5y percentiles while AUDUSD is only the 76th 1y. FACT: Paper book already has long AONIA_2026-10 (catalyst-junkie) and long AONIA_2027-06 (perma-bear) versus this seat's short Mar-27; cross-merchant is already short AUDCAD. FACT: Fed delivered 25bp to 3.75-4.00 with SOFR 3.85; SR3H7 implies 4.565 (+71.5bp); BoJ hiked to 1.25%; desk thesis says the energy shock is constraining global easing. INFERENCE: The crowded trade is 'housing caps the RBA, receive front AONIA and/or fade AUDCAD from a 5y extreme.' That ownership is in Oct OI, in 99th-percentile AU bonds, and in the obvious cross fade. Mar-27 AONIA at 4.86 still prices only about two hikes and is almost unowned, even though the 2Y is already 4.999. Paying that empty terminal owns the squeeze if inflation 82 plus delivered global tightening force the RBA through the housing constraint, without joining crowded AUD-longs (OI extreme, net not extreme) or the crowded AUDCAD short. UNKNOWN: post-15 Sep CFTC, CME daily OI (403), live ASX depth, and the next RBA decision. Do not OPEN a second AONIA_2027-03.
